title: Aimfox workspace provisioning · result
description: Response body of the webhook (responseMode: lastNode) and the return value of the sub-workflow. Also the shape persisted to client_sequencers.setup_state, minus `candidates`. It must never contain an api_key: the gateway derives booleans and the key stays server-side (process doc, invariant 7).

state.description: configured = the whole canonical set is present. partial = some elements were missing (and were created unless dry_run). missing = the workspace resolved but nothing was wired. needs_selection = the workspace could not be resolved unambiguously and a human must choose. client_not_found = the client_id matched no client with an enabled connector — a caller error, reported out loud rather than allowed to end the run silently.

reason.description: Present when state is needs_selection or client_not_found. Says why in one sentence, so the operator does not have to open the execution.

read_only_iteration.description: True while the workflow contains no write node at all. Iteration 2 adds the writes and drops this flag.

matched_by.description: Resolution order, first hit wins. `explicit` — the caller supplied the id. `stored` — client_sequencers already holds one for this client, so no search is needed. `name` — exactly one workspace matched the client name. There is no fuzzy value on purpose: an inexact match must terminate in needs_selection (invariant 2). Measured 2026-08-07: only 4 of 9 wired clients match their workspace by name, so `stored` carries most of the real traffic and `name` is really only for a brand-new client.

candidates.description: Only present when state is needs_selection. Already filtered: every workspace whose id appears in client_sequencers, for any client and any sequencer, is excluded — offering one would invite the misassignment that put GIC's workspace on Prac.Finansowa.

outcome.description: ok = already present, nothing done. created = was missing and has been created. missing = was missing and was NOT created (dry_run). skipped = the step could not run because an earlier one failed. failed = the vendor rejected the call.

present.description: Element identities already at the vendor. Webhooks are identified as "<events joined by +> <url>", never by name (invariant 4).

missing.description: Element identities the canonical set requires and the vendor does not have. Same identity format as `present`.
